description: SAC Steel Project Database is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ekin Gultepe, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). The SAC Joint Venture was formed in mid-1994 with the specific goal of investigating the damage to welded steel moment frame buildings in the 1994 Northridge earthquake and developing repair techniques and new design approaches to minimize damage to steel moment frame buildings in future earthquakes. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 2 top-level files (CSV). Its DOI is 10.4231/d3fq9q536. Keywords: ATC , CUREE, SEAOC, earthquake engineering , steel structures, structural engineering. Published 2013-03-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
